risks.description: Exact official PTR evidence can be unavailable; the intended output remains partial rather than a fabricated conclusion.

At the live smoke time, Blizzard News timed out at the bounded two-second read while retrieved Blizzard Forum entries did not match 12.1 PTR. The current-source tool therefore recorded failed and the answer did not make a strength claim.
The pre-existing wow-chickenbro-source-refresh service remains failed and was not restarted; this release performed no sync/backfill start and does not treat that baseline service state as healthy.
